name: opening_range_breakout_15_5s
author: adapted from Gemini Quant
thesis: Exploits institutional price discovery in the first 15 mins. The high/low of the first 15 mins often acts as a boundary for the day's trend as orders from overnight news are processed. This isn't arbitraged because of the high slippage and volatility at the open.
mechanism: Consolidation periods accumulate resting orders above resistance and below support. A breakout triggers these resting orders as stop-losses and breakout entries fire simultaneously. The resulting order flow imbalance overwhelms the resting liquidity, and market makers widen spreads in the breakout direction, accelerating the move.
weaknesses: Large SL required if ORB range is wide
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; apply to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index instead of FnO universe. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
